HEBRLANG 1: In the first-year program, students acquire essential Hebrew through abundant opportunities to interact in the language in meaningful ways. The students learn to function appropriately in the language in various social and cultural contexts.
HEBRLANG 2: Continuation of HEBRLANG 2. Prerequisite: Placement Test, HEBRLANG 2.
HEBRLANG 3: Continuation of HEBRLANG 2. Prerequisite: Placement Test, HEBRLANG 2. Fulfill the University Foreign Language Requirement.
HEBRLANG 21: Continuation of HEBRLANG 3. Sequence integrating culture and language. Emphasis is on proficiency in oral and written discourse, including presentational language and socio-culturally appropriate discourse in formal and informal, academic, and professional contexts. Prerequisite: Placement Test, First Year Hebrew.
HEBRLANG 22: Continuation of HEBRLANG 22. Sequence integrating culture and language. Emphasis is on proficiency in oral and written discourse, including presentational language and socio-culturally appropriate discourse in formal and informal, academic, and professional contexts. Prerequisite: Placement Test, Hebrew 22.
HEBRLANG 23: Continuation of HEBRLANG 22. Sequence integrating culture and language. Emphasis is on advanced proficiency in oral and written discourse, including presentational language and socio-culturally appropriate discourse in formal and informal, academic, and professional contexts. Prerequisite: placement Test, HEBRLANG 22.
HEBRLANG 395: Prerequisite: For Grad Students Only and Consent of Instructor
